ability.name: Subnet Detection
ability.description: Establish the network ranges based on context check metrics.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null}; $(try { $error.Clear(); $cidr = '192.168.187.0/24'; Write-Output $cidr | Out-File C:\Windows\Temp\bas\network_cidr.txt -Encoding ascii; Write-Output "NETWORK_CIDR: $cidr" } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\step1.txt

rationale: Determines the primary scope for active sweeps.
